import re
from collections import Counter

WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text, k):
    words = WORD_RE.findall(text.lower())
    counts = Counter(words)
    ordered = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return ordered[:k]
